ja: 彼らに無理やり署名させられないで。
en: Don't let them railroad you into signing.
alternatives: Don't allow them to pressure you into signing.
Don't let them strong-arm you into signing.
point: railroad 人 into は強引に承諾させる。

ja: 財布は昨日なくなりました。
en: My wallet went missing yesterday.
alternatives: I lost my wallet yesterday.
My wallet disappeared yesterday.
point: yesterday があれば過去形（has は使えない）

ja: 私の荷物はどこ？
en: Where's my luggage?
alternatives: Where is my baggage?
Where are my bags?
point: luggage は数えないので is を使う。

ja: タクシー運転手に、ぼられた。
en: A taxi driver ripped me off.
alternatives: I got ripped off by a taxi driver.
The cabbie ripped me off.
point: 「ぼられる」は get ripped off

ja: 運転手に止まるよう言って！
en: Tell the driver to stop!
alternatives: Please tell the driver to stop!
Tell the driver to pull over!
point: 「人に〜するよう言う」は tell + 人 + to do

ja: 彼が旅の危うさを分かるとは思えない。
en: I doubt he grasps how precarious travel is.
alternatives: I'm unsure he understands how risky travel is.
He may not grasp how precarious this trip is.
point: doubt の中に grasps、その中に how 節、precarious は危うい。

ja: 私が疑ってるのは相手の誠意だ。
en: It's their sincerity I'm calling into question.
alternatives: What I'm questioning is their good faith.
It's their sincerity that I'm questioning.
point: call into question は信頼性を疑問に付す。

ja: カードを止めてもらいたいです。
en: I need my card blocked.
alternatives: I'd like to have my card blocked.
I want my card frozen.
I need to get my card blocked.
point: have/get/need + 物 + 過去分詞

ja: 足止めでも私は卑屈にならない。
en: Though stranded, I won't grovel.
alternatives: I won't grovel, even though I'm stranded.
I refuse to grovel, though I'm stranded.
point: grovel は卑屈に振る舞って頼む。

ja: 席の下の鞄がなくなった。
en: The bag under my seat's gone.
alternatives: My bag under the seat is gone.
The bag beneath my seat is missing.
point: 名詞の後ろに前置詞句を置いて説明する

ja: 私、家に電話したい。
en: I want to call home.
alternatives: I'd like to phone home.
I want to phone my family.
point: want to do は行動の希望。

ja: バッグがなくなったみたいです。
en: It seems my bag's gone missing.
alternatives: I think my bag has gone missing.
It looks like my bag's missing.
point: It seems で断定を避け、やわらかく伝える

ja: 私、領事館へ行くよ。
en: I'll visit the consulate.
alternatives: I'm going to the consulate.
I'll go to the consulate.
point: consulate は領事館。

ja: パスポートが、どこにもなかった。
en: Nowhere could I find my passport.
alternatives: I couldn't find my passport anywhere.
My passport was nowhere to be found.
point: Nowhere を文頭に出すと could I の語順に倒置

ja: 荷物が見つかったら知らせて。
en: Tell me when it turns up.
alternatives: Tell me when it's found.
Let me know when it shows up.
point: turn up は探していた物が見つかること。

ja: 私は既に口上を鵜呑みにしてた。
en: I'd already swallowed their spiel.
alternatives: I'd already bought their sales pitch.
I'd already taken their pitch at face value.
point: swallow a spiel は口上を鵜呑みにする。

ja: 次の電車の方が早いです。
en: The next train is faster.
alternatives: The next train is quicker.
The next one is faster.
point: 「〜の方が早い」は faster の一語

ja: 少し助けが必要です。
en: I need a little help.
alternatives: I need some help.
I could use a little help.
point: help は数えない名詞なので a help とは言わない

ja: カードを今日再発行できる？
en: Can you reissue my card today?
alternatives: Could you reissue my card today?
Can I get my card reissued today?
point: 「できますか」は Can you で相手の可否を聞く

ja: 今どこにいるか、わからない。
en: I don't know where I am.
alternatives: I have no idea where I am.
I'm not sure where I am.
point: 間接疑問は where のあとが平叙文の語順

ja: 私は紛失の届け出を終えた。
en: I finished reporting the loss.
alternatives: I've finished filing a loss report.
I filed the loss report.
point: finish の後には動名詞。

ja: 予約にミスがあります。
en: There's a booking error.
alternatives: There's a mistake in my booking.
My booking has a mistake.
point: 「〜がある」は There's + 名詞

ja: 財布をなくさなければよかった。
en: Wish I hadn't lost my wallet.
alternatives: I wish I hadn't lost my wallet.
If only I hadn't lost my wallet.
I shouldn't have lost my wallet.
point: 過去の後悔は wish + had (not) done

ja: 私が急げば、間に合ったのに。
en: If I'd hurried, I'd have made it.
alternatives: I'd have made it if I'd hurried.
If I had hurried, I would have made it.
point: make it は「間に合う」

ja: 私は助けを待ってる。
en: I'm waiting for help.
alternatives: I'm waiting for some help.
I'm still waiting for help.
point: am waiting で助けを待っている最中と伝える。

ja: ここで止まって。
en: Stop here, please.
alternatives: Please stop right here.
Please stop at this spot.
point: stop here でその場で止まるよう頼む。

ja: 確認メールが、まだ届いてません。
en: My confirmation email hasn't arrived yet.
alternatives: I still haven't received the confirmation email.
The confirmation email still hasn't arrived.
point: yet は否定文で「まだ〜ない」

ja: 私が領収書を残してたら今争えるのに。
en: Had I kept receipts, I'd have recourse.
alternatives: If I'd kept receipts, I'd have recourse now.
Keeping the receipts would've given me recourse.
point: Had I kept は if を省く倒置で、今の対抗手段を仮定する。

ja: 財布がなくなった。
en: My wallet is gone.
alternatives: My wallet is missing.
I lost my wallet.
point: なくなった は is gone か is missing

ja: 私なら予約の証拠を見せる。
en: I'd show proof of booking.
alternatives: In your shoes, I'd show booking confirmation.
I'd show reservation confirmation in your place.
point: I'd は相手の立場ならそうするという助言。

ja: 係員が荷物を探しています。
en: They're looking for my luggage.
alternatives: Someone is looking for my luggage.
The staff are searching for my bag.
point: 探している最中は現在進行形

ja: 私は歩けない。
en: I can't walk.
alternatives: I'm not able to walk.
Walking is impossible for me.
point: cannot walk で歩くことができないと伝える。

ja: 私たちは宿へ戻るよ。
en: We'll return to the hotel.
alternatives: We're going back to the hotel.
We'll head back to the hotel.
point: will はこれからの行動を伝える。

ja: 荷物が別の空港に回されました。
en: My bag was rerouted to another airport.
alternatives: My luggage was sent to a different airport.
My bag has been sent to another airport.
point: 「回された」は受け身。reroute が自然

ja: パスポート、タクシーに忘れたかも。
en: I might've left my passport in the taxi.
alternatives: I may have left my passport in the cab.
Maybe I left my passport in the taxi.
point: 過去の可能性は might have + 過去分詞

ja: 一文なしで立ち往生、助けて！
en: Stranded without a cent, I need help.
alternatives: I'm stranded without a cent and need help.
Stranded and penniless, I need your help.
Stranded and broke, please help me.
point: 「一文なし」は without a cent。分詞構文で状況を添える

ja: 予約に手違いがあったようです。
en: There seems to be a booking mix-up.
alternatives: It looks like there's a mix-up with my booking.
I think there's been a mix-up with my booking.
point: seems to be で断定を避け、柔らかく切り出す

ja: 問題があります。
en: There's a problem.
alternatives: Something is wrong.
We have a problem.
point: 「問題がある」は There's a problem

ja: 午前中ずっと、保留にされてる。
en: I've been on hold all morning.
alternatives: I've been on hold since this morning.
I've been stuck on hold all morning.
I've been waiting on hold all morning.
point: all morning と続く状態は have been

ja: 私の鍵が効かなくなった。
en: My key stopped working.
alternatives: My key no longer worked.
My key quit working.
point: stopped working は使えなくなった過去。

ja: 別の便に振り替えは可能ですか？
en: Would it be possible to rebook me?
alternatives: Is there any chance you could rebook me?
Could I possibly be rebooked on another flight?
point: Would it be possible to 〜 で丁寧に頼む

ja: 警察を呼んでください。
en: Please call the police.
alternatives: Could you call the police?
Can you call the police?
point: 「警察」は the police と the をつける

ja: なくしたのは鞄でなくパスポート。
en: It's my passport I lost, not my bag.
alternatives: It was my passport I lost, not my bag.
What I lost was my passport, not my bag.
point: It is 〜 that 〜 で「〜なのは」を強調する

ja: 私はあの保証を鵜呑みにすべきでなかった。
en: I shouldn't have taken that assurance at face value.
alternatives: I shouldn't have accepted that assurance without question.
I should've questioned that assurance instead of trusting it.
point: take at face value は言われたことを疑わず受け取る。

ja: 預けた荷物が届いていません。
en: The bag I checked hasn't arrived.
alternatives: My checked bag still hasn't arrived.
The bag I checked in hasn't arrived.
point: 目的格の that は省略できる

ja: 電話を貸して！
en: Lend me your phone.
alternatives: Let me use your phone.
Can I borrow your phone?
point: 命令文は主語なしで動詞から始める

ja: もっと早い便はありますか？
en: Is there an earlier flight?
alternatives: Do you have an earlier flight?
Is there an earlier flight available?
point: 「もっと早い」は earlier、前に an

ja: 運転手にぼられて、返金してほしい。
en: Fleeced by a cabbie, I want a refund.
alternatives: Having been fleeced by a cabbie, I want a refund.
A cabbie fleeced me, so I want a refund.
Overcharged by a cabbie, I'd like a refund.
point: 「ぼられる」は be fleeced。分詞で理由を添える

ja: 私、宿を探さなきゃ。
en: I must find accommodation.
alternatives: I have to find accommodation.
I need somewhere to stay.
point: accommodation は宿泊先を表す。

ja: 荷物は明日届くと言われました。
en: They said it would arrive tomorrow.
alternatives: I was told it would arrive tomorrow.
They told me it would arrive tomorrow.
They said it'd be here tomorrow.
point: said の後は will が would に変わる

ja: パスポートがないです。
en: My passport is missing.
alternatives: My passport's gone.
I can't find my passport.
I don't have my passport.
point: 「ない」は missing でも言える

ja: 私たち、急いでいれば間に合ったのに。
en: If we'd hurried, we'd have made it.
alternatives: We'd have made it if we'd hurried.
Had we hurried, we'd have made it.
point: 「間に合う」は make it。過去の仮定は had + 過去分詞

ja: 財布をなくした。
en: I lost my wallet.
alternatives: I've lost my wallet.
I lost my wallet somewhere.
point: 「なくした」は lose の過去形 lost

ja: 確かにここに置いたんです。
en: I'm sure I left it here.
alternatives: I know I left it here.
I'm positive I left it here.
I'm certain I left it here.
point: sure の後は that を省略して節をつなぐ
